events.title: v3.0.7
events.summary: Patch notes:Changing the resolution in settings now changes in-game resolution instead of just window size. This should improve performance for those having problems with it.Fixed game breaking bug when changing resolution.Fixed visual glitch during screen shakes.

events.title: We're back in the Fall In Love Fest 2026 + v3.0.6 Update!
events.summary: Lately we've been thinking. Who are we? What do we want? Why are we here?Our little game project got caught up in these kinds of thoughts too. It doesn't help that we have such an exciting mix of genres going on! Because, let's be real: what are we? Yes, we have horror elements. Yes, there's a dark mystery hidden in the soil, waiting to be uncovered. Yes, we want to ask big philosophical questions and take a stand against discrimination and fear. events.title: 10,000 wishlists, Games Made in Germany, and a Episode 1 update!

events.title: Rottenroots Episode 1 - Patch 3.0.2
events.summary: Blossom Brightly, everyone! Kurt here! I, uh, got asked to deliver this update report. Let me check my notes...Improved overall performance. Things should run a lot smoother now! I-I double-checked myself.Fixed some audio issues. Some sounds were acting up and... well, that's not protocol. Like multiple songs overlapping?! Now that's no fun. Good someone fixed that. Hopefully.Enhanced the log UI. It's easier to scroll back and reread things now! You know, in case you missed something important.

events.title: Fall In Love Visual Novel Festival
events.summary: In Rottenroots, you're not only fighting your way through the Sundown - you're also fighting your way into your beloved's heart. Which end of this love triangle will be your choice? Your secret lover James, or the ambitious Audrey?
